```sql
WITH forest_boundary AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Chequamegon–Nicolet National Forest'
),
longest_road_in_forest AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.geometry, r.road_name, ST_Length(r.geometry::geography) AS length_meters
  FROM roads r
  JOIN forest_boundary fb
    ON ST_Intersects(r.geometry::geometry, fb.geom)
  WHERE r.highway IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY length_meters DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
road_raster_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      (SELECT geom FROM longest_road_in_forest),
      TRUE
  ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
      r.rast::geometry,
      (SELECT geom FROM longest_road_in_forest)
  )
),
road_slope_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ST_DumpAsPolygons(clipped_rast, 1) AS slope_dump
  FROM road_raster_clip
),
slope_values AS (
  SELECT
    (slope_dump).val AS slope_degrees
  FROM road_slope_stats
)
SELECT
  lr.road_name,
  ROUND(AVG(sv.slope_degrees)::numeric, 2) AS average_slope_degrees
FROM longest_road_in_forest lr
CROSS JOIN slope_values sv
GROUP BY lr.road_name;
```
